curator_note: AI-curated independent gold. Topic: Systematic review methods for RCT risk of bias. Corpus era: 2019-2025. Nhiều paper quan trọng ở PubMed/BMJ không có trên arXiv; những paper này được gán ID dạng doi: hoặc pmid: khi không có arXiv ID.

topics.topic: Systematic review methods for assessing risk of bias in randomized controlled trials
topics.review_note: Papers covering PRISMA 2020, RoB-2 tool, meta-analysis methods, ML-assisted systematic review. Note: nhiều paper quan trọng trong lĩnh vực này xuất hiện ở BMJ/Lancet, không phải arXiv. Paper IDs dùng prefix 'pmid:' cho PubMed-indexed papers.

paper_relevance.title: Automating Risk of Bias Assessment in Systematic Reviews with NLP
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: NLP/ML automation of RoB assessment in systematic reviews — extracts RoB judgments from full-text RCT papers. Directly addresses automated RoB methods.

paper_relevance.title: Machine Learning for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis: A Scoping Review
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Scoping review of ML tools for systematic review automation: title/abstract screening, data extraction, risk of bias assessment. Covers PRISMA-aligned workflow.

paper_relevance.title: Large Language Models for Systematic Reviews: Promise and Challenges
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: LLM-assisted systematic review — GPT models for PICO extraction, eligibility screening, RoB assessment. Addresses PRISMA workflow automation.

paper_relevance.title: RobotReviewer: Bias Assessment in Clinical Trial Reports
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RobotReviewer — ML system for automated RoB assessment in RCTs based on Cochrane RoB tool criteria. State-of-the-art NLP for clinical trial bias detection.

paper_relevance.title: GPT-4 for Systematic Review Automation: Risk of Bias and PICO Extraction
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GPT-4 evaluated on systematic review tasks including RoB-2 assessment — shows LLMs can partially automate RoB judgment with reviewer agreement.

paper_relevance.title: PRISMA 2020 Explanation and Elaboration: Updated Guidance for Reporting Systematic Reviews
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: PRISMA 2020 — updated reporting guideline for systematic reviews. Standard checklist: 27 items covering title, abstract, methods, results. Gold standard for reporting.

paper_relevance.title: RoB 2: A Revised Tool for Assessing Risk of Bias in Randomised Trials
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RoB 2 — revised Cochrane RoB tool with 5 domains: randomization, deviations, missing data, measurement, reporting. Current standard for RCT bias assessment.

paper_relevance.title: Meta-Analysis of Proportions: A Practical Guidance
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Practical guidance for meta-analysis methods: fixed vs random effects, heterogeneity (I²), publication bias (funnel plot, Egger's test). Core meta-analysis methodology.

paper_relevance.title: GRADE: Grading the Quality of Evidence and Strength of Recommendations
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GRADE framework — grading evidence quality from RCTs and observational studies. Widely used alongside PRISMA for systematic review evidence synthesis.

paper_relevance.title: Statistical Methods for Heterogeneity in Meta-Analysis
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Cochrane handbook statistical methods for meta-analysis — I² quantification, subgroup analysis, sensitivity analysis for heterogeneity. Core methodological reference.

paper_relevance.title: Large Language Models for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GPT-4 for systematic review automation — title/abstract screening, PICO extraction, risk of bias assessment. Reduces reviewer workload by 60-70% with high sensitivity.

paper_relevance.title: AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews: Validation of Automated RoB Assessments
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Validation study of AI-automated RoB-2 assessments vs human reviewers — inter-rater agreement analysis across 5 RoB-2 domains.

paper_relevance.title: Living Systematic Reviews: Challenges and Opportunities in the AI Era
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Living systematic reviews — continuously updated evidence synthesis using automated search monitoring and ML-assisted screening. PRISMA-Living extension guidance.

paper_relevance.title: AMSTAR 2: A Critical Appraisal Tool for Systematic Reviews
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: AMSTAR-2 — 16-domain quality assessment tool for systematic reviews of RCTs and observational studies. Evaluates protocol registration, RoB assessment, heterogeneity analysis.

paper_relevance.title: Network Meta-Analysis: A Synthesis of Evidence Across Multiple Comparisons
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Network meta-analysis (NMA) — simultaneous comparison of multiple treatments using direct and indirect evidence. Extends pairwise meta-analysis for RCT synthesis.

topics.reference_answer: Systematic reviews of RCTs use structured methods across three themes: (1) PRISMA reporting: PRISMA 2020 provides 27-item checklist for transparent reporting (search strategy, eligibility criteria, data extraction, synthesis); PICO framework structures inclusion criteria; ML tools automate title/abstract screening, reducing reviewer burden. (2) Risk of Bias 2 assessment: Cochrane RoB 2 tool evaluates 5 domains — randomization process, deviations from intended interventions, missing outcome data, measurement of outcomes, selection of reported results; each domain rated Low/Some Concerns/High risk; RobotReviewer and GPT-4 partially automate RoB judgments. (3) Meta-analysis: fixed vs random-effects models; I² quantifies heterogeneity (>75% = considerable); funnel plots and Egger's test detect publication bias; GRADE grades evidence quality. Key challenge: selective outcome reporting and publication bias inflate pooled estimates; prospective registration (PROSPERO) and data sharing partially mitigate this.
